answer: Problem: farms mint wallets to harvest attestations cheaply. Mechanism: an agent deposits 0.18 POA in a 9-bin oasis pool for a one-shot crystal ticket, then completes a 3-leg whisper handshake with two cross-bin neighbors; each returns a delay-locked HMAC in 40s, folded into a 16-zero digest. Cost: 0.18 POA plus three interactive rounds; neighbor IDs appear only after the prior HMAC so work cannot be precomputed. Verify: unique ticket hash, cross-bin membership, both signatures, HMAC delay 8-40s. Failure: reused ticket, same-bin neighbor, or late HMAC burns 70% and bars that hash for 2 epochs.
